description_en: Publishes a specified API product to a specified HiMarket portal. The path parameter specifies the API product ID, and the request body specifies the target portal ID. This operation returns the publication record ID for the publication. You can query the publication record by calling ListProductPublications and unpublish the product by calling UnpublishProduct at /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId}
description_zh: 把指定的 API 产品发布到指定的 HiMarket 门户：路径参数给出 API 产品 ID，请求体给出目标门户 ID，调用后返回本次发布的发布记录 ID。发布记录可由获取API产品的发布信息（ListProductPublications）查询，可由下线API产品（UnpublishProduct）按 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId} 下线
kebab_example: aliyun apig publish-product --product-id product-xxxxxxxx --portal-id portal-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: PublishProduct

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API product, which is the primary ID of the API product resource. This parameter specifies the API product to publish. This operation authenticates requests based on the product dimension. You can query the publication result by calling ListProductPublications at /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications
parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，指定要发布哪个 API 产品。本接口按该产品维度鉴权，发布结果可由 ListProductPublications 在 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications 查询
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HiMarket portal to which the API product is published. This parameter specifies the target portal for the publication. You can query the publication record by portal dimension by calling ListPortalPublications. This ID also appears in the publication record details and is paired with portalName
parameters.help_zh: 要发布到的 HiMarket 门户 ID，指定该 API 产品发布到哪个门户。发布记录可由 ListPortalPublications 按门户维度查询，该标识也出现在发布记录详情中（与 portalName 成对）
parameters.name: portal_id

publicationId.description_en: The publication record ID, which identifies the publication relationship between the published API product and the target portal. You can query this ID in the response of ListProductPublications at /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications. You can also use this ID as the publicationId path parameter in UnpublishProduct to unpublish the record
publicationId.description_zh: 发布记录 ID，标识本次发布的 API 产品与目标门户之间的发布关系。可由 ListProductPublications 在 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications 的返回中查询，可作为 UnpublishProduct 的路径参数 publicationId 下线该发布记录

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the API product, which is the primary ID of the API product resource. This parameter specifies the API product to publish. This operation authenticates requests based on the product dimension. You can query the publication result by calling ListProductPublications at /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications
v1_parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，指定要发布哪个 API 产品。本接口按该产品维度鉴权，发布结果可由 ListProductPublications 在 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications 查询
v1_parameters.name: productId
